items.stem: Which role normally leads technical/workflow depth in DITL?

options.text: An uninformed observer.
A certificate-generation script.
Procurement alone.
SE, with AE and agreed partner contributions.

items.stem: A domain expert partner is new to Glean. Which model is most appropriate initially?

options.text: Require the customer to certify the partner first.
Make unilateral product and commercial commitments.
Skip all preparation because industry expertise is enough.
Co-facilitate with Glean technical backup and reviewed outputs.

items.stem: Which stakeholder mix best covers workflow discovery?

options.text: Only the vendor's sales team.
Only procurement and legal.
Business owner, representative frontline user and relevant technical/data owner, with sponsor path.
Only senior executives with no workflow experience.

items.stem: When should value-specialist help be considered?

options.text: Never; all estimates must be generated without review.
Only after all contracts expire.
When complexity, attribution or executive stakes exceed a simple self-serve case.
For every deal as a guaranteed customer entitlement.

items.stem: A partner-built agent appears to expose a platform defect. What is the best route?

options.text: Use the Glean product support path with safe diagnostic evidence.
Expand access to every repository to work around it.
Promise the partner will change the Glean platform code.
Ignore the defect and call it a feature.

items.stem: A partner wants to promise an unverified write-back integration. What should happen?

options.text: Tell the customer write actions never need review.
Move it into the SOW without an assumption note.
Pause the claim and assign feasibility/security validation before commitment.
Approve it because it appears in a generated diagram.

items.stem: What should a deal-specific operating agreement clarify?

options.text: That all decisions are jointly owned with no accountable person.
Only the meeting background image.
Communication, artifact ownership, technical answers, approvals and follow-up owners.
That the partner may bypass all internal gates.

items.stem: Which statement about partner services is accurate?

options.text: A services catalog guarantees any custom capability.
Partner-led means Glean has no account responsibility.
Every workshop automatically creates a signed SOW.
Discovery can inform a reviewed scope but does not itself authorize delivery work.
